# Alexandria structure data

Provider: Alexandria Materials Database. Dataset: PBE.
API: https://alexandria.icams.rub.de/pbe/v1/
Terms and attribution: https://alexandria.icams.rub.de/about.html
Data license: CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ .
Terms checked 2026-10-31 on the provider's official About page.

This app queries the provider only after user action. No database is bundled.
Applied inputs/projects retain provider, dataset, identifier, source URL,
original geometry hash, license and modification status. Geometry and band YAML
exports carry attribution. Model-generated results are not Alexandria results.
The app's source license does not replace the terms of fetched third-party data.
No provider endorsement is implied.

Suggested reference: Cavignac et al., Journal of Physics: Materials 9, 025014
(2026), https://doi.org/10.1088/2515-7639/ae6620 .
